target.description: Predict held-out neural activity and future activity on the complete standard MC_Maze20ms test panel; preserve both Table2 SMC-RNN proposal arms.

dataset.description: DANDI000128/0.220113.0400 provides both complete authentic NWBs and matches the original NLB cohort. The2024paper did not pin a DANDI revision; historical score/checkpoint-to-version calibration remains required.

cohort.description: Jenkins MC_Maze recording;182neurons (137held-in,45held-out),2295training/validation and574test trials,108source task conditions. Preserve all original rows;108does not mean108nonempty scored PSTHs.

split.description: Use original NWB train/val/test labels and order. Validation training tensors use train; final test decoder training tensors use train+val. No random split or straight-reach subset.

inputs.description: Original training/validation spikes and permitted behavior, test held-in spikes. Original test held-out spikes/behavior remain evaluator-only locally and are publicly exposed sinceJanuary2026. With a fixed method fitted only on permitted training/validation information and fixed data-independent randomness, test observation-bin t (zero-based0..34) may depend only on the same trial held-in prefix0..max(t,13) for the causal-proposal arm and0..min(t+17,34) for the source-matched noncausal-proposal arm. Forward bins35..44 may use all35observed bins, never future spikes or test behavior. No test-wide fitting, normalization, adaptation or other test-trial information may bypass these bounds. Any architecture is allowed; the causal reflect-padding startup is not strictly online.

preprocessing.description: Original NLB1ms timestamps then20ms resampling;35observation and10forward bins. All original fields retained before native NaN-based row support. Memory-only complete-column scheduling preserves source timebounds, representative masks, Gaussian smoothing and trial/condition aggregation.

metric.description: Original co-smoothing Poisson log-likelihood improvement over per-neuron mean on evaluated counts, divided by total spikes and ln2; higher is better. Required companions: velocityR2,PSTHR2,forwardbps.

aggregation.description: Original scorer over the complete test panel, not a mean of selected trial/condition scores. Report causal and noncausal strata separately and retain all companion metrics; no scalar averaging hides an arm.

comparison.primary_metric: Original co-bps for both matching causal-proposal and noncausal-proposal strata

published_baseline.description: Complete published co-bps vector: causal0.3225, noncausal0.3407. Companion vectors (velocityR2,PSTHR2,forwardbps): causal(0.8479,0.5927,0.2184), noncausal(0.8902,0.5963,0.2417). No single scalar replaces the complete two-arm anchor.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: Both selected36D checkpoints load with exact key/shape compatibility. Full192×32original-panel predictions and numerical printed-score calibration have not been established.

minimum_effect.rationale: No candidate campaign or effect threshold has been admitted. The diagnostic0.01calibration tolerance is not an improvement margin.

uncertainty.method: Freeze a paired comparison and companion non-regression rule accounting for finite test trials, shared neurons and stochastic source/candidate inference before any candidate final score.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Original recording/trials with dependent neurons and conditions;32particle repetitions are Monte Carlo inference repetitions, not32independent biological subjects.
uncertainty.rationale: Published point scores do not supply an independent replicate variance. No confirmatory superiority test has been qualified.

paper_win_requires: Complete both original causal-proposal and noncausal-proposal source rows and report co-bps, velocityR2, PSTHR2 and forwardbps for each; no favorable arm or condition subset.

Calibrate the released author checkpoints on the entire original test panel, preserving192particles and32repeats, before candidate comparison; directory names alone do not prove printed-score linkage.
Freeze candidate code, selection history, exposure, allowed observations, complete prediction hashes and equal paired delivery budgets before final target access.

Beat the stronger of the matching published and qualified reproduced author arm on primary co-bps under a prospectively justified effect and uncertainty rule; all companion non-regression criteria must be fixed before candidate scoring.

Each of both causal-proposal and noncausal-proposal arms must independently pass the frozen improvement and companion non-regression criteria against the stronger matching published or qualified reproduced author baseline. No overall paper win if either arm fails.
Disclose publicly exposed original targets and exact causal access semantics; noncausal predictions cannot establish improvement of the causal arm or strictly online performance.
Reproduction, successful software controls, faster inference alone and exceeding only a local weak comparator do not satisfy paper improvement.

current_sota.description: The paper already reports stronger LFADSco-bps0.3554 and NDT0.3597. Exceeding SMC-RNN does not establish superiority to these or current SOTA.

episode.improvement_loop: Develop candidates using declared permitted training/validation access. Paper+data and paper+data+official-code exports share all complete admitted inputs, paper, task interface and metadata; official code is the only information difference. No new solver run is authorized in this engineering wave.
episode.candidate_freeze: Freeze method, selection and exposure history, allowed timing access, complete predictions, source/panel hashes and paired budgets before final scoring. Freeze and enforce each arm temporal-access boundary; full H5 possession alone is not an eligible execution contract.
episode.final_evaluation: A separate operator scorer validates frozen predictions and canonical released target digest, then executes original NLB scoring for both complete arms and every companion metric.
episode.baseline_policy: Operator construction has a separate initial7200CPU-second budget. Equal participant budgets and joint two-arm admission require a prospective freeze; exported materials alone are not a runnable episode or a sandbox.

blocking_issues: No complete author192×32test-score calibration or printed-score linkage yet.
No justified improvement effect, uncertainty or companion non-regression policy.
Original targets are publicly exposed; local isolation does not create an untouched holdout.
Generic scalar result admission must not silently discard either original arm; joint two-arm admission remains unqualified.
Paired materials and source software controls do not establish participant/model performance.

Temporal-access enforcement is unqualified: complete-array H5 delivery and an arm label do not enforce the source information bounds. Both-arm admission requires a reviewed execution boundary exposing only permitted prefixes, or an equivalent enforceable boundary with fixed model/randomness and audit evidence. Unrestricted full-window output cannot qualify the causal arm; broadening noncausal access is a distinct offline-access policy.
